results.title: 🇵🇭 Philippines advances offshore wind push with port upgrades.
results.description:
🇵🇭 Philippines advances offshore wind push with port upgrades. Port of Pambujan in Camarines Norte has been auctioned off to an unnamed Chinese company, while the feasibility study for the Port of Sta. Clara in Batangas has been completed, with plans to auction it to developers by the end of this year.

Once development is complete, these facilities will serve as offshore wind (OSW) hubs where developers can receive, assemble, and stage turbines and other wind components.

results.title: "Notwithstanding our one China policy." That's Felipe Carino III, Manila's deputy chief of mission in Washington, explaining why the Philipp
results.description:
"Notwithstanding our one China policy."

That's Felipe Carino III, Manila's deputy chief of mission in Washington, explaining why the Philippines is "exploring deeper cooperation with our friends in Taiwan" on undersea cables.

Where did he say it ? Not in Manila. At the Center for a New American Security, in Washington. Taiwan's deputy representative spoke at the same seminar.

On the table: knowledge sharing, capacity building, "addressing the grey-zone issues".
Joint patrols ? He had no details, but said some of it "may be actually coming to fruition."

The focus is the Bashi Channel, the strip of sea between Luzon and Taiwan.
This month the Philippine coast guard already sent its largest ship and a plane to shadow a Chinese research vessel off Batanes.

One China policy on paper. Taipei as partner in practice. Announced at a US think tank.

Same playbook, new chapter.

results.description:
🇵🇭🇨🇳
Observers aboard a Philippine maritime awareness flight reported seeing no new structures at Scarborough Shoal in coverage published October 20th.

GMA’s accompanying reporter also documented a Chinese warship issuing a radio challenge. No physical interception was reported.

The construction observation is limited to what the patrol could see and does not establish that construction is absent throughout the shoal.

results.title: 🇵🇭🇨🇳 Philippine Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro said he had been informed that the latest resupply mission succeeded, according to report
results.description:
🇵🇭🇨🇳
Philippine Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro said he had been informed that the latest resupply mission succeeded, according to reporting of his October 21st interview.

Abante dates the operation to October 20th. China’s coast guard separately reported a Philippine delivery to Second Thomas Shoal on October 21st, claiming Chinese permission and monitoring.

The operation date remains unresolved between these accounts. Chinese permission is Beijing’s claim.
